about: Backported features from the FM-1 scene: one build switch each (firmware/src/backports.h; tools/build.py passes FELUCCA_x=0/1). Costs measured on feat/backports-features in the fitting config (FELUCCA_SAMPLES_SKIP=SCRCH FELUCCA_DLY_LEN=32768): the switch alone on, minus the same build with every backport switch at 0 (base 571,328 B flash, RAM 92,480 B, pool 282,192 B, RAMTEXT 32,016 B). A switch at 0 builds code and data identical to the tree without the feature (checked per feature by comparing the ELF sections). The builder shows 'notice' next to the switch; 'warning': true marks an item it must show as a WARNING (X0X-derived or experimental).

items.title: Per-step chance (probability) on the synth tracks
files: hooks: seq.c seq_step, params.c STEP 2 page, ui_draw.c, ui_input.c step_edit, editor.c ed_step_in

cost.cpu: one test per NOTE step; a random number only on a step below 100 %

items.storage: bits 2..6 of step_t.flags (unused before): 0 = 100 %, k = 100 - 5k %; projects (FUN8), undo and copies keep them in every build; a build without the switch plays every step
items.limits: 5 % grid (Felucca: 1 %); synth tracks only (dstep_t has no free bits); a TIE step is not rolled; the web editor shows no chance yet (a step written from it keeps its chance)
items.notice: Per-step chance after Felucca 1.0 by Leo Kuroshita (GPL-3.0).
